import json, sys
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By
from selenium.webdriver.common.keys import Keys
from selenium.webdriver.chrome.options import Options
from selenium.webdriver.chrome.service import Service
from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait
from selenium.webdriver.support import expected_conditions as EC
settings=json.loads(sys.argv[1]);base=settings['url'];driver=None
flags={'delayedHeading':False,'deliberateFocus':False,'abandonedRoute':False}
try:
    options=Options();options.binary_location='/usr/bin/chromium'
    for value in ['--headless=new','--no-sandbox','--disable-dev-shm-usage','--window-size=1440,1000','--disable-background-networking']:
        options.add_argument(value)
    driver=webdriver.Chrome(service=Service('/usr/bin/chromedriver'),options=options)
    driver.set_page_load_timeout(10);driver.set_script_timeout(5);wait=WebDriverWait(driver,8,poll_frequency=.1)
    driver.get(base+'/#/login')
    wait.until(EC.visibility_of_element_located((By.NAME,'email'))).send_keys('focus-owner@example.test')
    driver.find_element(By.NAME,'password').send_keys('correct focus password')
    driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'form button[type=submit]').click()
    wait.until(EC.visibility_of_element_located((By.CSS_SELECTOR,'nav[aria-label="Main navigation"]')))
    script='''const original=window.fetch;window.focusGate={ready:0,done:0,releases:[],release(){for(const next of this.releases.splice(0))next();}};
    window.fetch=async(...args)=>{const response=await original(...args);if(new URL(args[0],location.href).pathname===TARGET){window.focusGate.ready++;await new Promise(resolve=>window.focusGate.releases.push(resolve));window.focusGate.done++;}return response;};'''.replace('TARGET',json.dumps('/api/v1/issues/'+settings['issueId']))
    driver.execute_cdp_cmd('Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument',{'source':script})
    def opening(case):
        driver.get(base+'/?focus-case='+case+'#/issues/'+settings['issueId'])
        wait.until(lambda d:d.execute_script('return window.focusGate?.ready>0'))
        assert not driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'main h1'), 'The delayed resource must initially have no heading'
    def release():
        driver.execute_script('window.focusGate.release()')
        wait.until(lambda d:d.execute_script('return window.focusGate.done>0'))
    def correct_title(d):
        return d.execute_script('const h=document.querySelector("main h1");return h&&document.title===h.textContent+" · Crew"')
    opening('default');release()
    wait.until(lambda d:any('Async route focus' in h.text for h in d.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'main h1')))
    wait.until(correct_title)
    wait.until(lambda d:d.execute_script('return document.activeElement===document.querySelector("main h1")'))
    flags['delayedHeading']=True
    opening('manual')
    driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'a.brand').send_keys(Keys.ARROW_RIGHT)
    assert driver.execute_script('return document.activeElement.matches("a.brand")')
    release();wait.until(correct_title)
    assert driver.execute_script('return document.activeElement.matches("a.brand")'), 'Arrival must not steal deliberate keyboard focus'
    flags['deliberateFocus']=True
    opening('abandon')
    driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'a.brand').click()
    wait.until(lambda d:any(h.text=='Overview' for h in d.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'main h1')))
    release();wait.until(correct_title)
    assert driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'main h1').text=='Overview'
    assert driver.execute_script('return document.activeElement===document.querySelector("main h1")')
    flags['abandonedRoute']=True
except Exception as error:
    state=driver.execute_script('return {title:document.title,headings:[...document.querySelectorAll("main h1")].map(h=>h.textContent),active:document.activeElement?.tagName,activeClass:document.activeElement?.className,gate:window.focusGate?{ready:focusGate.ready,done:focusGate.done}:null}') if driver else None
    print(json.dumps({'error':str(error),'state':state,'flags':flags}),file=sys.stderr)
    raise
finally:
    if driver:driver.quit()
print(json.dumps(flags))
